(18 matches) | prevseason = [[2024–25 Algerian Ligue 2|2024–25]] | nextseason = [[2026–27 Algerian Ligue 2|2026–27]] | updated = 9 May 2026 }} The '''2025–26 Algerian League 2''' is the 62nd season of the [[Algerian League 2]] since its establishment and the first one under its new name.{{cite news|url=https://lnf-amateur.dz/ar/article/16814|title=الرابطة الثانية: الشعار الجديد إلزامي على قمصان اللاعبين|language=ar|work=LNFA|publisher=Redaction team|date=18 August 2025}} The competition is organized by the [[Ligue Nationale du Football Amateur]] and consists of two groups of 16. At the end of the last game of the League 2, the 3 clubs that are ranked last in each group are relegated to the Inter Régions. The start of the 2025–26 season of the League 2 was on Friday, September 13, as announced by [[Ligue Nationale du Football Amateur]] in a press release published on the official website.{{cite web |url=https://lnfa.dz/2025/08/31/report-du-championnat-de-ligue-2-au-13-septembre/ |title=League 2 : Coup d'envoi de la nouvelle saison le 13 septembre |website=LNFA |date=31 August 2025 |access-date=15 September 2025}}{{cite web |url=https://lnfa.dz/2025/08/10/championnat-de-ligue-2-les-calendriers-de-la-saison-2025-2026/ |title=Le calendrier du championnat de Ligue 2 2025/2026 |website=LNFA |date=10 August 2025 |access-date=15 August 2025}} ==Teams== [[US Biskra]] and [[NC Magra]] were relegated from [[Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1]].{{cite web |url=https://www.entv.dz/%D9%85%D9%88%D9%84%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%AC-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%82%D8%A8-%D9%88%D9%86%D8%AC%D9%85-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A9/ |title=مولودية الجزائر تتوج باللقب ونجم مقرة يرافق اتحاد بسكرة إلى الرابطة الثانية |website=entv.dz |date=21 June 2025 |access-date=17 October 2025}} [[NRB Beni Oulbane]], [[MO Béjaïa]], [[JS Tixeraine]], [[WA Tlemcen]], [[CR Beni Thour]] and [[CRB Adrar]] were promoted from the [[Interregional Football League]].{{cite web |url=https://www.dzfoot.com/football-en-algerie/ligue-2-les-six-clubs-qui-accedent-en-deuxieme-division-279783.html |title=Ligue 2 : Les six clubs qui accèdent en deuxième division |website=dzfoot.com |date=25 May 2025 |access-date=17 October 2025}} On 26 June 2025, LNFA published the composition of each group.{{cite web |url=https://lnf-amateur.dz/en/article/16712 |title=Saison 2025/2026: La composante de deux groupes du championnat de ligue 2 adoptée par la LNFA |website=lnf-amateur.dz |date=26 June 2025 |access-date=18 October 2025}} ==Stadiums and locations== '''''Note:''' Table lists in alphabetical order.'' ===Group Centre-east=== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
